utterances.text: For example, on the first page you can see Pristina to SUP it was distributed some number and then to PJP and other numbers.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Yeah. And what we have here is the MUP staff issuing orders, is that right, which encompass the PJP?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: As we can see, they are distributing ribbons.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: But you're founding strongly on the fact that they're only now ordering their use and saying, Well, it's only following the order that the use can come into effect; is that right?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We don't see it that way, Your Honour, I have to --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Pretty plain in English as it stands.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We can read here that they just distribute. It says in Serbian. [Interpretation] It says "we deliver to" in Serbian.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Let's go back to page 1 then again.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: It says forwarding -- we are forwarding armbands for policemen.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: "All uniformed policemen moving outside these -- their premises in the open must wear armbands."

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Maybe somebody ordered it before -- we are forwarding the instructions on armbands.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you. Please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. [Interpretation] I will go back for a second to something I've already talked about and those are two documents. So let's compare the documents, P1459 and P1725. We can see that the same matter is talked of in two different ways. In the first document of the 25th of May it says that the only positive thing being done by the MUP is that it is bringing in military conscripts who are failing to respond to the call-up. Several days after that in P1725 of the 4th of June, in item 3 it says members of the MUP are insufficiently engaged in bringing in conscripts who are failing to respond to the call-up and they are even hiding them, covering up for them. So we see that these two documents differ. And could we now move into private session because I wish to comment on something that was said in private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Very well.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Does that complete your submission, Mr. Lukic?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, I said it in closed session. I should say it probably in the open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I thank you for your patience and for listening to our arguments. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CHOWHAN
utterances.text: Well, we are about to finish the proceedings and I thought my bound and duty to convey my sentiments and these are my -- through these sentiments I wish to congratulate all of you for this wonderful period that we spent, this skillful and erudite presentations and handling and the courtesies which were shown by everybody. I also take this opportunity of paying my respects to my learned colleagues, and now as you are going home I wish you all well. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: The other members of the Trial Chamber join Judge Chowhan in thanking counsel for assisting us with your submissions, and we're grateful to counsel and indeed to the parties for the generally professional and dignified way in which the case has been conducted. That brings us to the end of the hearing of the case. When we retire, we shall immediately embark on our deliberations and pronounce judgement as soon as possible on a date which will be announced by order in due course.

procedural_notes.text: [The Accused Pavkovic and Lazarevic not present]
--- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 4.41 p.m.
